newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's Lite-On Jan-Sept net profit up.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Lite-On Jan-Sept net profit up.

text.p: Taiwan's Lite-On Technology Corp, a leading computer monitor maker, said on Monday it posted a net profit of T$520.97 million between January and September, up 15.9 percent from the same period a year ago.
The company's combined sales revenue was T$15.975 billion in the first nine months, up 31 percent from the 1995 period, Lite-On said in a statement.
Lite-On, the world's fifth largest monitor manufacturer, has factories in Taiwan and Malaysia.
The company's operation in Scotland was expected to start production in the second quarter of 1997, the statement said.
